title: 19. Inclusive Growth, Financial Inclusion & JAM Trinity
summary: Inclusive growth ensures broad-based economic participation, accelerated by financial inclusion through the Jan Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile (JAM) infrastructure.

blocks.title: First-Principles Core Truth
blocks.summary: Inclusive growth ensures broad-based economic participation, accelerated by financial inclusion through the Jan Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile (JAM) infrastructure.

blocks.content: 1. Concept of Inclusive Growth: Economic growth that creates broad-based employment opportunities, reduces poverty, and ensures equitable access to health/education (11th & 12th FYP core mandate).
2. JAM Trinity Components: Jan Dhan Accounts (Universal banking access) + Aadhaar (Biometric identification) + Mobile (Digital transaction interface).
3. PM Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY - Aug 28, 2014): Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account (BSBDA) with Zero Balance, RuPay debit card, ₹10,000 overdraft facility, and accidental insurance.
4. RBI Financial Inclusion Index (FI-Index): Measures financial inclusion across 3 parameters: Access (35%), Usage (45%), and Quality (20%) on a 0-100 scale (No base year).

blocks.text:
⚡ 1. Key Features of PM Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
- **Universal Banking Access:** Unbanked households get a Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account (BSBDA).
- **No Minimum Balance:** Zero-balance account restriction removed.
- **RuPay Debit Card:** Comes with built-in ₹2 Lakh accidental insurance cover.
- **Overdraft Facility:** Up to **₹10,000** available for eligible account holders after 6 months of satisfactory operation (age limit: 18 to 65 years).
- **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** Eliminates middlemen by transferring subsidies directly into Aadhaar-linked accounts.

📖 2. RBI Financial Inclusion Index (FI-Index) Breakdown
Published annually by RBI in July (capturing data up to March):

blocks.content:
| Sub-Index | Weightage | Key Indicators Covered |
|---|---|---|
| **Access** | **35%** | Banking outlets, ATMs, BCs per 100k population |
| **Usage** | **45%** | Active accounts, digital transactions, credit off-take, insurance penetration |
| **Quality** | **20%** | Financial literacy, consumer protection, grievance redressal, micro-credit delinquency |
*Key Feature:* The FI-Index has **NO Base Year** (reflects cumulative efforts of all stakeholders).

blocks.text:
⚖️ 3. Common Prelims & Mains Traps
- ⚠️ **Exam Trap 1:** Overdraft under PMJDY is NOT available instantly upon account opening; it requires **6 months of satisfactory account operation**.
- ⚠️ **Exam Trap 2:** RBI FI-Index has NO base year, unlike CPI or WPI.

blocks.content:
#### Tier 1 — Recall MCQ
**Q:** Which sub-parameter holds the highest weightage (45%) in the annual Financial Inclusion Index (FI-Index) published by RBI?  
(A) Access  
(B) Usage  
(C) Quality  
(D) Literacy  
**Answer:** ** — Usage holds 45% weightage, Access holds 35%, Quality holds 20%.

#### Tier 2 — Applied Scenario
**Scenario:** A welfare scheme experiences 30% leakage due to ghost beneficiaries and delayed cash distribution. Explain how implementation of the JAM Trinity fixes this leakage.  
**Resolution:** Aadhaar biometric verification eliminates duplicate/ghost entries; PMJDY accounts provide direct destination endpoints; Mobile networks send instant transaction alerts via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

#### Tier 3 — Mains Descriptive Prompt
*'Evaluate the role of the JAM Trinity in accelerating financial inclusion and transforming social welfare delivery in India.'*
